topic: Army Agniveer rally at Gachibowli stadiu
hook: Army Agniveer rally at Gachibowli stadium, *Nov 13–24*: all 33 districts
hook_b: Got an Agniveer admit card? Here's where to report
tldr: The Army holds an Agniveer rally for all 33 Telangana districts at Gachibowli, Nov 13–24.

beats.what: Indian Army recruitment rally for Agniveers at GMC Balayogi Athletic Stadium, Gachibowli.
beats.why: It screens candidates for the 2027 recruiting year across four Agniveer categories.
beats.care: Have an admit card? Bring every original document. Ignore anyone asking for money.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The rally runs Nov 13–24 at GMC Balayogi Athletic Stadium, Gachibowli, for candidates from all 33 Telangana districts (The Hindu). Categories: Agniveer General Duty, Agniveer Technical, Agniveer Tradesman (10th pass) and Agniveer Tradesman (8th pass). Only candidates who received admit cards should report, with all documents in original as listed in the 2027 notification. The Army warns against touts: selection is automated and agents have no role. Info: joinindianarmy.nic.in · Army Recruiting Office, Secunderabad: 040-27740059. Day-wise district schedule was not in the report.

cards.q: Would you consider an Agniveer stint?
Who decides selection at the Agniveer rally?
cards.why: The Army says selection is automated and agents have no role.

insight: Only candidates with admit cards report; the Army says no agent can get you selected.

learn.t: Agniveer = a soldier recruited under the Agnipath scheme for a fixed term of service.
